bitchat.title: Bitchat
bitchat.description: Chat with nearby Bitchat users over Bluetooth, without an internet connection.
bitchat.privacy: Nearby public messages are readable by mesh participants. Private messages are encrypted in transit. Chat history is saved on this device.
bitchat.name: Your public name
bitchat.public_notice: Everyone in the nearby mesh can read public messages.
bitchat.private_notice: Private messages are encrypted. Compare the fingerprint with the person before sharing sensitive information.
bitchat.empty_hint: Keep Bluetooth on and another Bitchat device nearby.
bitchat.error: Unable to connect or send. Check Bluetooth, use an updated build, and try again.

mobile.geo_privacy: Location channels use the internet. Messages, names, and the selected area are public to relay operators and everyone listening. They are not encrypted private chats.
mobile.precision: Area size for Use my location
mobile.location_hint: Location permission is optional. Only the selected area code is sent, never exact coordinates. You can enter any area manually.
mobile.relays: Internet relays (one wss:// address per line)
mobile.failed: Unable to connect or send. Check Bluetooth, internet access, location permission, and the area or relay addresses, then try again.
mobile.storage_note: Messages and drafts are saved on this device until you clear local history. Connections pause in the background and reconnect when you return. Local history is not encrypted by Outlink.
mobile.mesh_privacy: Nearby public messages are readable by mesh participants. Private messages are encrypted in transit. Chat history is saved on this device.
mobile.geo_empty_hint: Keep the channel open to receive live public messages. Ephemeral channels do not guarantee history.
mobile.clear_confirm: Delete saved messages and drafts on this device? Other people and relays may retain copies.
